guard: an extension's alias runs its command, and an add whose name or alias another installed extension already claims as a name or alias fails naming both, read from the manifest cache without importing the sibling
why: An installed extension is not imported during another's add, so the registry cannot see its aliases; the add must compare the cached names and aliases, or two packages claim one word and the winner depends on install order. Run it without a seat's COTAL_* environment.

mutations.name: the add compares only cached names
mutations.find: e.pkg !== pkg && extensionProvides(e).some((ref) => ref.kind === provided.kind && providedWords(ref).includes(word)),
mutations.replace: e.pkg !== pkg && extensionProvides(e).some((ref) => ref.kind === provided.kind && ref.name === word),
mutations.expectRed: an alias an installed extension claims fails the add, naming both
mutations.cell: an alias an installed extension claims fails the add, naming both
